mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_opportunity_item WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN '商机产品' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_ticket WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN '服务工单' END

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_opportunity WHERE customer_id = #{id}) THEN '商机' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_ticket WHERE customer_id = #{id}) THEN '服务工单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_followup WHERE customer_id = #{id}) THEN '跟进记录' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_contact WHERE customer_id = #{id}) THEN '联系人' END

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_customer WHERE owner_id = #{id}) THEN '客户负责人' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_opportunity WHERE owner_id = #{id}) THEN '商机' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_lead WHERE owner_id = #{id}) THEN '线索' END
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_customer WHERE dept_id = #{id}) THEN '客户' END
